aide_p0_desc:
Welcome to the tactical navigation interface.
*Bot version: {version}*

**Browse the module documentation using the buttons below:**
aide_p0_f1_v: System tools, diagnostics, updates, and support.
aide_p0_f2_v: Account linking, live scores, goals, multi-session history, unified server leaderboard.
aide_p0_f3_v: Automated scanners for available fortresses on the world map.
aide_p0_f4_v: Player and alliance tactical analysis, player comparison, legal targeting, and RoE arbitration.
aide_p0_f5_v: Detailed alliance and player profiles, history, and peace shield.
aide_p0_f6_v: Monitoring tools and live alerts on competitors or rivals.
aide_p1_f0:
⚠️ **Before running a command, you must use: 
`/setup scope:👤 For me only (Personal) language: server: `
Without this, the bot will not work** ⚠️
aide_p1_f1: > Displays the bot's full user manual.
aide_p1_f2: > Checks the system's health status (latency, disk space, API status).
aide_p1_f3: > Discover the update notes and new features.
aide_p1_f4: > Lets players send a report or suggestion directly to the developer.
aide_p2_desc: History of event results, server information, and leaderboards.
aide_p2_v1:
• `/link_account [player]`
> Links a Discord account to a GGE in-game name.
aide_p2_v2:
• `/event_player [event_name] [player] [mode: Latest score/History]`
> Shows a player's live score or total.

• `/event_alliance [nom_event] [alliance] [affichage]`
> Generates the full internal member leaderboard.
aide_p2_v3:
• `/leaderboard woa `
> Shows the top of the latest Wheel of Abundance.

• `/leaderboard storm_islands `
> Shows the top Aquamarine looters.
aide_p2_v4:
• `/woa history [player]`
> Check the history of tickets spent.

• `/woa summary`
> Shows the server's overall economic activity.
aide_p2_v5:
• `/rival start [event_name] [threshold]` / `/rival stop`
> Enables or disables the secret radar in DMs.

• `/rival add [player]` / `/rival list`
> Manage your rival targets live.
aide_p2_v6:
• `/calendar setup [channel]`
> Lets you choose the channel where event information will be sent.

• `/calendrier track [alliance_name]`
> Lets you track an alliance's event results.

• `/calendrier untrack [alliance_name]`
> Removes an alliance from event tracking.

• `/calendrier current`
> Returns the events happening this month.
aide_p2_v7:
• `/rank player` / `/rank alliance`
> Global ranking and statistics (Player or Alliance).

• `/rank event [event_name]`
> Event rankings (Nomads, Bloodcrows, Foreigners, Samurais).

• `/rank gacha [event_name]`
> Special event rankings (King's Banquet, Hollow Moon, Flora...)

• `/rank league [league_name]`
> League rankings (Season, Kingdom League).

• `/rank realms [realm_name]`
> Realm rankings (Outer Realms, Beyond the Horizon).

• `/rank statistic [stat_name]`
> Global rankings (Honor, Might, Plunder, Legendary).
aide_p3_f1: > Automatic cascading search for available fortresses.
aide_p4_v1:
• `/alliance_scanner [alliance_name]`
> Full real-time roster (Targets / Peace shield order).

• `/proximite [my_player] [enemy_alliance]`
> Finds the closest enemies to your castle.

• `/target [attacker] [ruleset] (target_alliance)`
> Generates a list of legal targets according to the charter.

• `/hr [attacker] [defender] [ruleset]`
> Checks whether an attack is legal under the RoE.
aide_p4_v3:
• `/diplomatie add [my_alliance] [alliance_target] [status]`
> Registers an Ally, NAP, or War relation.

• `/diplomatie remove [my_alliance] [target]`
> Removes a diplomatic agreement.

• `/diplomatie list [alliance]`
> Privately shows the diplomatic registry.
aide_p5_v1:
• `/player [name]`
> Full player profile (Level, Might, Positions, Castles).

• `/alliance [name]`
> Detailed alliance profile and full paginated roster.

• `/dove [player]`
> Precise countdown before protection ends.
aide_p5_v2:
• `/history [player]`
> Tracks name, alliance, or castle changes.

• `/alliance_pp [alliance] [days]`
> Shows an alliance's overall might progression.
aide_p6_v1:
• `/radar add [player] (reason)`
> Puts a target under close watch (DM alerts).

• `/radar remove [player]`
> Removes a player from your personal monitoring.

• `/radar list`
> Centralized dashboard of all your active tracking.
aide_p6_v2:
• `/radar alliance add [alliance_name] (reason)`
> DM alert on Join, Leave, Promotion, or Demotion.

• `/radar alliance remove [alliance]`
> Stops the global monitoring of the alliance.
